name: io.franchisedata/mcp-server
description: Official Model Context Protocol (MCP) server for franchisedata.io — 500 US restaurant franchise chains, statutory FDD Item 19 unit economics, 210,000+ store locations, POS hardware fingerprints, and multi-unit franchisee ownership trees.

environmentVariables.name: FRANCHISE_API_KEY
environmentVariables.description: Optional FranchiseData Pro API key (fc_live_…) for unmasking full FDD records and batch data — get one at https://franchisedata.io/topup

environmentVariables.name: FRANCHISE_MODE
environmentVariables.description: Tool scoping mode to optimize agent context window: 'all' (default), 'discovery' (6 tools), 'diligence' (10 tools), 'operations' (13 tools)

environmentVariables.name: FRANCHISE_COMPACT
environmentVariables.description: Token optimizer toggle: 'true' (default, trims 40-60% tokens) or 'false'
